superseded.reason: The v1 measurement harness misidentified its metrics (owner review of #414/#415): readyMs excluded process launch, imports, and initialization (its timer started only after the LUGAS_STARTER_READY line, so 13ms/11ms is the /api/ready confirmation fetch, not launch-to-readiness); RSS and SIGTERM were sampled/sent to the `bun run` script-runner process rather than the server (bun run start:built spawns a runner); and shutdownExit discarded the child's real exit code. The v1 workload also did not require ok responses with consumed bodies and folded the settle delay into workloadMs. These are measurement-definition errors, not run-to-run noise.
superseded.doNotUseFor: server-memory or startup comparisons, including the 13ms-vs-11ms and 8.0-vs-7.9MiB figures
superseded.supersededBy: lugas-starter-measurement-v2 outputs of the repaired scripts/measure.ts

note: Measurements to establish, not promised savings. RSS bounds are process-resident footprint on this machine/run, not a guarantee; the queue/memory claims live in ADR-0036/ADR-0037, not here.
